sum: Amaero Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of refractory and titanium alloy spherical metal powders for additive manufacturing and advanced manufacturing. The company offers titanium additive manufacturing powders, refractory additive manufacturing powders, and powder metallurgy hot isostatic pressing components. It serves various industries, such as defense, space, aerospace, oil and gas, industrial, heavy industry, medical, and energy industries in the United States. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in McDonald, Tennessee.
ceo: Mr. Hank J. Holland (Executive Chairman, President & CEO)
